items.title: Smart glasses in sights of Fringe venue, Adelaide council

children.content: As local governments in parts of Australia introduce bans on smart glasses, an Adelaide city councillor and a prominent Fringe venue are floating the idea of significantly restricting use of the devices in public spaces.

items.title: Disability advocate's tragic drowning spurs life-saving gesture

items.title: Nearly 1,700 sea dragons reported dead during SA's algal bloom

items.title: Faster medical examinations for sexual assault survivors under SA reform

children.content: Skilled midwives will now conduct forensic examinations in sexual assault cases to reduce lengthy waits for victim-survivors after SA Health figures showed there were only 12 trained staff in the state.

items.title: Disgraced MP who fraudulently claimed public money avoids jail

items.title: Housing Trust apologises to tenant after delays to remove black mould

items.title: Geologist hopes to find evidence of underwater volcano
